review_comment: The patch exposes a Python object to JavaScript without visible access controls. While DeveloperExtrasEnabled is disabled, the 'py_bridge' object remains accessible to JavaScript content. Implement method-level authorization checks on the exposed Python object to ensure only safe, intended methods can be called from untrusted JavaScript contexts.
